reading_link_cycles.note: Cycles among reading-interface edges are reported for navigation only; they are not proofs, inference rules or semantic entailments.

semantics.preparation_order_semantics: Default author-directed manuscript preparation; not a runtime dependency. Later explicit per-document instructions and existing independent authorized work retain their scope.

relation_kinds.addresses-planned-scope: A manuscript unit covers topics of an RM definition; not completion or a whole-task alias.
relation_kinds.extends-existing-path: Planned work develops an existing manuscript; the current editorial revision does not complete the plan.
relation_kinds.has-candidate: A complete candidate exists at the pinned path; not scientific or publication acceptance.
relation_kinds.informs-not-blocks: Advisory relation from the roadmap, not a start gate.
relation_kinds.reading-interface: Source-grounded conceptual cross-reference; may form cycles and is not an inference rule.
relation_kinds.states-bounded-claim: Identifies an authored summary and its premises; the source argument remains authoritative.
relation_kinds.uses-term: Reading crosswalk to a shared term, not a claim of identical implementation semantics.
